summary: Implemented LINK-5 keyboard connection picker with searchable targets, provenance filtering, create/retype/delete, card detail and card list entry points, announced counts/errors, focus restoration, 13 component tests, and a keyboard-only Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented LINK-5 keyboard connection picker with searchable targets, provenance filtering, create/retype/delete, card detail and card list entry points, announced counts/errors, focus restoration, 13 component tests, and a keyboard-only Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.
decisions: The picker is a canvas-free Dialog that writes through an injected ConnectionRepository and reports resulting rows to the parent page.
Existing pairs are retyped instead of duplicated, preserving the connection ID and pair key.
Attach source opens on Provenance with Source targets; provenance selection filters to Sources for notes and Notes for sources, while Association stays unfiltered.
The picker is rendered only while open and keyed by card and intent, so initial state comes from props without a cascading reset effect.
interfaces: ConnectionPicker props: open, currentCard, cards, connections, intent='connect'|'attach-source', repository?, loadRepository?, initialConnectionId?, onClose, onConnectionCreated/Changed/Deleted
CardListPanel props added: connectionRepository?, loadConnectionRepository?, onConnectionCreated/Changed/Deleted
agentReportedTests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/keyboard-links.spec.ts: 3 passed (desktop 1440x900, tablet 1280x800, phone 390x844)
warnings: Card detail is covered for picker reachability and focus return; the full create/retype/delete persistence journey is exercised from the card list.
LINK-HR-1 still owns the human visual and board-feel review.
validationLimitations: Component tests run in jsdom; the e2e journey provides the real-browser viewport and IndexedDB evidence.
payload.taskDescription: Create ConnectionPicker as a dialog with a searchable target list, type radio group, Save, and Cancel. From card detail and the card list, Connect to… opens it; from a note, a separate Attach source action opens it filtered to Sources. From a source, provenance targets are filtered to Notes. The picker can also retype or delete an existing connection. Announce target count and validation, restore focus to the trigger, and expose no canvas dependency. Add a Playwright keyboard journey that creates an association and a provenance link, retypes one, deletes one, and verifies persistence.
